description: This PHP class defines a data transfer object (DTO) for filtering search parameters related to sharing a Buzz Post in the OrangeHRM Buzz plugin. It extends a base FilterParams class and includes a property for Post ID with getter and setter methods.

classes.name: BuzzPostShareSearchFilterParams
classes.description: A Data Transfer Object (DTO) class used to encapsulate search filter parameters specifically for sharing Buzz posts, including a postId filter.

methods.name: getPostId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the post to filter shares by, nullable integer.

methods.name: setPostId
methods.description: Sets the ID of the post to filter shares by; accepts a nullable integer.
